projectInfo.name: Overland Baseball Website
projectInfo.description: Baseball team website with admin features, events, roster management, and theme customization

techStack.styling: Material-UI v5 with extensive custom theme

namingConventions.files: PascalCase for components, camelCase for utilities

layoutPatterns.pageStructure: Hero (optional, full-width) + Container + Grid for main content
layoutPatterns.contentGrid: Grid container with responsive columnSpacing using useMediaQueries

TextBlock.purpose: Flexible layout wrapper using MUI Stack - replaces manual flex/text styling
TextBlock.usage: Use as a container for any content that needs flex positioning - ALWAYS prefer this over raw divs or manual flex styling
TextBlock.notes: Simple wrapper around MUI Stack - use this for consistent spacing and layout patterns

SectionLayout.purpose: Standardized section spacing and margins with responsive breakpoints
SectionLayout.usage: Wrap all page sections with this component for consistent spacing throughout the site
SectionLayout.notes: Provides consistent 4rem->8rem margins across breakpoints, use for all major page sections

SectionHeader.purpose: Consistent header pattern with title, subtitle, and optional CTA
SectionHeader.usage: Use for all section headings instead of manual Typography combinations
SectionHeader.example: <SectionHeader title='Our Team' subtitle='meet the players' cta={button} />
SectionHeader.notes: Includes TextBlock internally, provides uppercase subtitle styling and flex layout

Container.purpose: MUI Container for main page content with semantic HTML
Container.usage: Use Container component='main' with semantic id and aria-label for all main page content
Container.notes: Standard pattern for main content areas, provides consistent padding via theme overrides

Grid.purpose: MUI Grid system with responsive spacing using useMediaQueries
Grid.usage: Use Grid container with columnSpacing based on useMediaQueries breakpoints
Grid.notes: Standard spacing pattern: isLg ? 6 : 4 for column spacing, components handle own Grid item wrapping

DataTable.purpose: Reusable styled table components for consistent table styling across pages
DataTable.usage: Import specific styled components needed for table layouts - single source of truth for all table styling
components: StyledTableContainer - Main split-table wrapper with responsive design
StyledFixedTable - Fixed column table for name columns in split layouts
StyledScrollableTable - Scrollable table for data columns in split layouts
StyledScrollContainer - Horizontal scroll container for data overflow
StyledTableHeader - Themed header row with conditional rounded corners for split/regular tables
StyledTableRow - Row with alternating color support (not currently used)
StyledTableCell - Standard cell with theme spacing and conditional bottom border removal
DataTable.notes: Centralized table styling - feature-specific player/content styling should remain in feature directories. Supports both split-table layouts (roster) and regular table layouts (future)

useMediaQueries.purpose: Custom responsive hook that provides all theme breakpoints as boolean values
useMediaQueries.usage: Import and destructure needed breakpoints for conditional rendering and styling
useMediaQueries.notes: Preferred over MUI breakpoint utilities - provides consistent responsive logic across components

dataFetching.errorHandling: Query error boundaries and status checks

styling.methodology: Material-UI v5 with extensive custom theme
styling.responsive: useMediaQueries hook for conditional rendering - preferred over MUI breakpoint utilities
styling.theming: Custom palette with primary (#091F40), secondary (#4CBB17), comprehensive typography scale

forms.validation: React Hook Form with control/handleSubmit pattern
forms.submission: AWS SES via custom useEmailService hook + axios
forms.errorDisplay: Custom FormStatusIndicator component + hook-based error states

layout.pageStructure: Hero (optional, full-width) + Container + Grid for main content
layout.contentGrid: Grid container with responsive columnSpacing using useMediaQueries
layout.sectionHeaders: SectionHeader as Grid item (xs=12) for SSR compatibility
layout.pagePattern: Navigation + Container + Grid > [SectionHeader + Feature Components as Grid items]
layout.sections: Always wrap major sections with SectionLayout within Grid items
layout.headers: Use SectionHeader for consistent section titles - place as dedicated Grid item
layout.spacing: Prefer TextBlock over manual div containers
layout.responsive: Use useMediaQueries for all conditional rendering and spacing

imports.order: MUI components first, React, then local components with // Comments grouping
imports.grouping: Group related imports with descriptive comments

javascript.style: Modern ES6+ syntax with React functional components
javascript.propTypes: Using PropTypes for type checking (not TypeScript)

imports.ordering: MUI first, React, then local components with comment grouping
imports.aliasing: Standard relative paths, no path aliases configured

functions.style: Arrow functions for components and utilities
functions.async: async/await with React Query for data fetching
functions.error: React Query error boundaries and status handling

responsive.approach: useMediaQueries hook for all responsive logic
responsive.rendering: Conditional rendering based on hook values

_template.relationships: How it relates to other models
